description: Lists the UK Parliament bills whose records changed most recently, with current stage, house, upcoming or latest sitting dates and status. A quick "what is moving through Parliament" view for public affairs teams and journalists. Source: UK Parliament Bills API. Ordered by when Parliament last updated the bill record, which usually but not always reflects new parliamentary activity. (cost: 1 credit)

take.description: integer, optional, bills to return 1-100, default 10

name: bills_recently_updated
